scripts.trendTopic: Hinglish Tech Explainers Outperforming Pure English Reels
scripts.thesis: Creators lose retention not from bad cameras, but from speaking in textbook English instead of how founders actually think and talk.
scripts.audiencePainPoint: Spending weekends recording 12 retakes that still get scrolled past in 2 seconds.
scripts.ctaStrategy: Ask viewers to comment "SCRIPT" or share whether they prefer Hinglish breakdowns.

variants.hook3s: Seedha point pe aate hain — aapki reel log 2 second mein scroll kyun karte hain?
variants.body: Aap lighting aur camera upgrade karte rehte ho, lekin audience ko chahiye clarity unki apni bhasha mein. Jab aap complex AI workflow ko simple Hinglish mein break down karte ho, retention turant upar jaata hai.
variants.cta: Batayein comments mein: aapka next explainer English mein chahiye ya Hinglish mein?

variants.hook3s: Three structural shifts driving higher retention on bilingual tech reels in 2026.
variants.body: First, anchor your opening three seconds in a concrete operational problem. Second, match vocabulary to everyday founder conversation rather than formal documentation. Third, deliver one actionable takeaway under thirty seconds.
variants.cta: Save this framework before recording your next batch.

variants.hook3s: Maine 4 ghante ki lighting setup chhod di — aur output double ho gaya.
variants.body: Sach bolun toh pehle har video ke liye tripod, mic, aur 18 retakes lagte the. Ab focus sirf sharp writing aur clean digital twin delivery pe hai.
variants.cta: Follow karein agar aap bhi creator burnout se nikalna chahte hain.

integrations.name: n8n HTTP Request / Instagram API Node
integrations.description: Configurable n8n-style HTTP Request Node supporting GET/POST/PUT/PATCH, Bearer/Header/Query auth tokens, custom headers JSON, and template variables ({{videoUrl}}, {{caption}}, {{hashtags}}).
integrations.notes: Works like an n8n HTTP Request node or Meta webhook bridge. Use Test Node to inspect live HTTP response codes and JSON body.

integrations.name: Facebook Page Graph API Direct Post
integrations.description: Connect your Facebook Page ID & Page Access Token to upload and publish Reels/Videos directly to your Page via Meta Graph API v21.0.
integrations.notes: Enter your Facebook Page ID and long-lived Page Access Token with pages_manage_posts & publish_video permissions.

integrations.name: Instagram Graph API Direct Post
integrations.description: Connect your Instagram Professional/Creator Account ID & Meta Access Token to create Reels containers and publish directly via Graph API v21.0.
integrations.notes: Requires IG User ID, Meta Graph Access Token (instagram_content_publish), and an HTTPS public media URL so Meta servers can fetch the MP4.

integrations.name: Free Natural Hindi & Indian Neural Voice
integrations.description: Zero-cost neural speech engine for fluent Devanagari Hindi, conversational Hinglish, and Indian English voices (Madhur, Swara, Prabhat, Neerja).
integrations.notes: Active in $0.00 Free Tier for Persona Creation & Studio MP4 renders. Distinct from paid personal voice cloning.

integrations.name: Free Hugging Face ZeroGPU Lip-Sync Space
integrations.description: Optional $0.00 community Gradio Space bridge (e.g. LivePortrait / SadTalker ZeroGPU Space) for neural facial animation.
integrations.notes: Paste any public Hugging Face Gradio Space endpoint URL to run free cloud lip-sync when available.

integrations.name: Free Live Motion & Expression Animator
integrations.description: Zero-cost 30fps multi-expression animator driving head sway, eye-blinks, speech-energy mouth crossfades, camera cuts, and kinetic captions.
integrations.notes: Runs 100% free in Studio and masters to H.264 MP4 via local FFmpeg.

integrations.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen & Speech
integrations.description: Server-side script generation (EN/HI/Hinglish), speech transcription, and expressive TTS voice auditions.
integrations.notes: Active on server. Standard voice personas only — never mislabelled as personal voice cloning.

integrations.name: Local FFmpeg Mastering Studio
integrations.description: Deterministic server-side MP4 video assembly with portrait framing, audio muxing, subtitles, and provenance watermarks.
integrations.notes: Local FFmpeg binary verified on server.

integrations.name: Gemini Omni / Veo Video Generator
integrations.description: Photorealistic image-to-video motion generation via Gemini Interactions API. Always gated by explicit cost approval.
integrations.notes: Requires paid-tier API key and per-job cost authorization in Video Studio.

integrations.name: Local Kokoro / Piper TTS Worker
integrations.description: Zero-cost local neural TTS HTTP adapter for draft synthesis and offline experimentation.
integrations.notes: Optional zero-cost fallback. Configure your local Kokoro or Piper HTTP endpoint URL to enable.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs Personal Voice Clone
integrations.description: Authorized personal voice cloning connector for Hindi, Hinglish, and English emotional inflection.
integrations.notes: Never substituted silently. Must be explicitly configured and authorized.

integrations.name: LivePortrait / HeyGen Lip-Sync Worker
integrations.description: Dedicated facial expression driving and audio-driven lip-synchronization worker webhook.
integrations.notes: Connect a remote LivePortrait GPU endpoint or HeyGen webhook URL.

integrations.name: n8n Workflow Orchestrator
integrations.description: HMAC-SHA256 signed webhook dispatch and callback receiver for automated multi-step publishing.
integrations.notes: Configure any webhook URL (e.g., your n8n production trigger) to dispatch live workflow events.
